# T-1: Expose project preset inventory

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Provide or expose a project-aware preset inventory path that `presets list` can use without duplicating registry merge logic.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 inventory includes core presets and enabled plugin presets for a project root.
- R3 inventory falls back to core presets when project registry is absent or unavailable.
- R5 setup candidate and chain resolver semantics are not changed.
- R6 inventory collection enforces the 512 preset entry cap before rendering.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer a small exported helper in `src/lib/presets.js` if existing internal `allPresets(projectRoot)` is sufficient. Keep non-strict registry loading for inspection fallback.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests should construct a plugin-backed temp project using existing helper patterns and assert the inventory or command output contains plugin presets.
